text:
maya: Quick sync — need final scope for the enterprise field pilot (keystore + audit retention) by EOD. Sales pushed for tiered retention and exportable evidence for legal holds; legal wants SOC2 alignment. Can we align gating criteria?

ev an: Sales feedback is mixed — a few pilots need 7y retention, most are fine with 1–3y. Recommend tiers: standard (90d), extended (7y) — extended requires BYOK + dedicated routing. :thinking_face:

ben: +1 for tiers. Also add exportable chain-of-custody (JSONL + SHA256 hashes) so legal can ingest into their tools.

lena: Ops note — 7y at hot storage is untenable. Proposed lifecycle: hot (30d), cold (2y), archive (7y, object-lock, compressed). We should surface estimated $/GB/year to sales.

ashley: From Legal: we can provide control alignment docs for SOC2/ISO in pilot, but not full attestation. Offer a SOC2 prep package + evidence export playbook as acceptance criteria.

evan: KMS note: BYOK handshake needs HSM-backed KEK. We should support AWS KMS + on-prem HSM for Private customers. Escrow option for legal hold requests is requested by a bank pilot.

ben: Rollout gating (proposal): 1) BYOK handshake flow documented + tested 2) retention lifecycle UI & API 3) evidence export API (24h SLA for exports) 4) ops runbook for legal hold and restore.

maya: Draft launch buckets: Pilot (closed, sales-led) -> Controlled GA (customers with contractual SLAs) -> GA. Pilot must have: BYOK handshake, export API, archive pipeline, and evidence playbook.

lena: I'll start the ops runbook: retention restore steps, legal-hold override playbook, cost apportionment tagging. Will include alerting thresholds for archive pipeline.

ben: Quick retention matrix for the thread:
```
hot: 30d
cold: 731d (2y)
archive: 2555d (7y)
```

ashley: PM asks — can we provide a simple customer-facing cost estimate? E.g. $0.XX / GB / year for archive + per-export fee. Need examples for 100GB, 1TB.

evan: I'll run numbers and post here. FYI SOC2 scoping may add ~4–6 weeks if customer requests formal attestation; prep docs are faster.

sre-bot: Incident notice: archive pipeline deploy failed in staging, tracking INC-2323. No customer impact.

maya: Thanks team. Actions: @lena draft ops runbook, @evan KMS feasibility + cost scenarios, @ben produce export spec (format + API), @ashley legal acceptance template and SOC2 prep packet. I'll compile everything for the EOD stakeholder readout. :thumbsup:
